Hi Scott,

Thanks for coming back to me, and good news first: your order Shop···· is in and paid, with the BS-4 shipping October 31.

On the colour, you're not missing anything. The listing carries only one option, the AC plug matched to your address, so the store can't take a colour choice at all. The two photos show the white and black finishes, but ordering as-is doesn't let either of us pick one, which is why I don't want to promise you black off my own bat.

I've put your note in front of Georges with your order number, flagged that black is what you want rather than just a preference, and asked him to confirm the finish with Bitfortun before the unit is packed. He's on today and will come back to you here with a straight answer.

If black genuinely can't be had, tell me and we'll sort out what you'd rather do with the order.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
